acceptance_rule: Preflight remains at least 5 independent announcement dates and 10 eligible tickers per window with top sector at most 35 percent. Gate evaluation must be PIT safe, after 35 bps round trip cost, positive aggregate expected_value_score and PnL, nonnegative treatment minus cash in every window, and must not materially worsen drawdown or concentration. SPY and QQQ matched-interval replacement are reported and failure to beat both in most windows rejects promotion. Daily output remains default off and cannot alter production decisions.
